title: Hearty Lacquered Brazilian Pork Dumplings
description: Rich and tender Brazilian dish featuring wonton skin and lacquer glaze, cooked in a donabe vessel, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and perfect for a monsoon day. The combination of pork, spices, and lacquer glaze creates a delicious and hearty meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped pork, soy sauce, brown sugar, ginger, and garlic, and mix well.
Lay a wonton skin on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the skin.
Brush the edges of the skin with a small amount of water and fold the skin into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining wonton skins and pork mixture.
Heat the vegetable oil in the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the vessel, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Brush the lacquer glaze over the dumplings and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until the dumplings are golden brown and cooked through.
Garnish with chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
